answer: Locks are published in saffron, expire in trellis, and sonnet lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 8 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 105 aliases therefore needs 160 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 65 dollars in locked collateral and another 6 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
